description: An enclave inference leaf folded into an ERC-8281 anchored manifest as an evidence-class-tagged entry ('attested, not recomputed'). Conformant iff the class is well-formed, keeps the three TEE claims separate, disclaims recomputation, and is committed by the leaf content-address so it survives the fold. Negatives MUST fail.

vectors.name: attested-leaf-ok
vectors.description: Well-formed attested TeeML leaf: enclave-attested class, disclaims recomputation, three TEE subclaims explicit (only hardware authenticity asserted, image/freshness honestly null), class committed by the content-address.

vectors.name: attested-tag-dropped
vectors.description: Negative: the evidence_class marker is missing — a fold would anchor the enclave leaf with no way to know it is attested, not recomputed.

vectors.name: claims-recomputed-for-enclave
vectors.description: Negative: the leaf claims INDEPENDENT_RECOMPUTATION for the enclave model-call root. The model call is attested by the enclave, never recomputed — this is the exact over-claim the tag exists to stop.

vectors.name: missing-recompute-disclaimer
vectors.description: Negative: attested class but does_not_establish omits INDEPENDENT_RECOMPUTATION — a downstream consumer could read the attested model call as recomputed.

vectors.name: missing-semantic-verification-disclaimer
vectors.description: Negative (mirror of missing-recompute-disclaimer, found by @babyblueviper1): attested class but does_not_establish omits SEMANTIC_VERIFICATION — a consumer could read the attested model call as judged correct. Execution integrity is not judgment.

vectors.name: conflates-authenticity-with-authorization
vectors.description: Negative: asserts image_authorized=true with no image_authorization_evidence — collapses TEE claim (1) hardware authenticity into claim (2) expected-image authorization. Authenticity is not authorization.

vectors.name: class-not-committed-by-content-address
vectors.description: Negative: the class fields are present on the leaf, but leaf_digest was computed over a class-less preimage (the anchor folded it as a plain step). The class would NOT survive the fold — the anchored root wouldn't cover it.
